metadata.title: Secure Storage Violation & Drift SSPP
metadata.remarks: Defines what constitutes a security violation or unacceptable drift within secure storage systems and establishes mandatory escalation requirements. This SSPP prevents normalization of insecure states and ensures governance visibility.

import-profile.remarks: Violation and drift conditions derive from secure storage SSPPs governing cryptography, integrity, lifecycle, and telemetry and SHALL NOT redefine authority or operational response.

system-characteristics.system-description: Defines violation classification, drift detection expectations, and escalation triggers for secure storage systems.

system-implementation.remarks: Secure storage SHALL NOT operate in a violated or drifted state without governance awareness. Violations and unacceptable drift SHALL trigger mandatory escalation.

components.description: Logical framework for identifying and classifying storage security violations and drift conditions.

roles.title: Secure Storage Violation Architecture
roles.remarks: Defines violation and drift classification criteria for secure storage systems.

roles.title: Secure Storage Violation Oversight
roles.remarks: Ensures detected storage violations and drift escalate appropriately and cannot be suppressed.

roles.title: Secure Storage Risk Governance
roles.remarks: Accepts, rejects, or mandates remediation of storage security violations.

violation-definitions.statement: Any loss, weakening, or bypass of required cryptographic protection constitutes a storage security violation.
Unauthorized modification, deletion, or rollback of immutable data constitutes a storage security violation.
Premature deletion or expiration of data subject to retention or legal hold constitutes a storage security violation.
Suppression, loss, or corruption of required storage telemetry constitutes a storage security violation.

drift-definitions.statement: Deviation of storage configuration from approved secure storage SSPPs constitutes unacceptable drift.
Deviation of effective storage behavior from approved policy intent constitutes unacceptable drift.

prohibited-drift-actions.statement: Storage security drift SHALL NOT be accepted as a normal operational condition.
Storage platforms SHALL NOT self-correct or mask drift without governance visibility.

escalation-requirements.statement: Detected storage security violations SHALL escalate to governance and SecOps without suppression.
Unacceptable storage drift SHALL escalate for review and resolution.
Resolved or unresolved violations SHALL require a documented risk decision.

control-implementation.description: Violation and drift controls ensure insecure storage states are visible, classified, and escalated.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Continuous monitoring detects violations and drift.
Escalation and response thresholds are defined for security violations.
Configuration changes and deviations are controlled and reviewed.

statements.statement: Storage security violations SHALL NOT be silently tolerated.
Drift is a governance concern, not an operational inconvenience.
All storage violations SHALL result in an explicit risk decision.

back-matter.remarks: Platform, relying system, and operations SSPPs SHALL enforce escalation behavior consistent with this SSPP.
